scientific_integrity: Proof is an induction using a fully inspected published append recurrence; finite code checks are corroboration, not a substitute for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: No classification of all extremizers, fixed-length optimum, or larger alphabets; unresolved possibility of an unindexed earlier frequency-specialized result. The 2003 conference version has no independently established exact initial dissemination date.
title: Sharp minority-frequency bound for minimal forbidden scattered subwords
